column2: I waited at the DMV for two hours on Tuesday just to renew my license.
The dog threw up on the living room rug again this morning.
Our flight was delayed three hours because of storms over Chicago.
I made spaghetti last night and the sauce splattered all over the stove.
The plumber said the water heater is shot and needs replacing.
I forgot my umbrella and got completely soaked walking to the train.
We spent the whole weekend cleaning out the garage. Found boxes we have not opened since we moved in.
The baby finally slept through the night on Thursday.
I locked my keys in the car at the grocery store parking lot.
The meeting ran so long I missed my lunch break entirely.
You want to salt the pasta water before it comes to a boil.
The mechanic says to change the oil every five thousand miles.
If that leak gets any worse you need to call the landlord.
Do not plant the tomatoes until after the last frost.
Back up your photos before you update the phone software.
The city council voted to repave Main Street starting in June.
A new coffee shop opened on the corner of Fifth and Elm.
The high school team won Friday's game twenty-one to fourteen.
The library is extending its weekend hours for the summer.
Gas prices jumped twelve cents a gallon this week.
The internet keeps dropping out every evening this week.
My neighbor's dog barks all night and I can barely sleep.
The line at the post office was out the door again today.
They raised the downtown parking rates and it is ridiculous.
The dishwasher leaves spots on everything no matter what detergent I try.
What time does the hardware store close on Sundays?
The prescription is ready for pickup after four o'clock.
I need to pick up milk and eggs on the way home.
The dentist said I have a cavity in my upper left molar.
Traffic on the freeway was bumper to bumper this morning.
My back has been killing me since I helped move the couch.
The kids tracked mud all through the hallway again.
I have a dentist appointment at three on Thursday.
The basement flooded a little during last night's storm.
She asked me to proofread her cover letter before Friday.
The new tires cost more than I expected.
I burned the toast because the toaster setting was too high.
The package was supposed to arrive Tuesday but it still is not here.
We need to replace the batteries in the smoke detector.
The landlord finally fixed the broken step on the porch.
